title: CircadianPOMDP: Julia software for circadian rhythm and sleep-wake particle-based simulation
description: Julia package for circadian rhythm and sleep-wake modeling with particle-based simulation, including jet lag experiments: baseline runs, timezone shifts, light interventions, and adaptation-time estimation. This release archives the software used in the accompanying manuscript. Included: source code, experiment scripts (steps 1–4) and the reviewer analyses behind the paper's figures and reported results, quickstart examples, and tests. Not included: generated simulation outputs under Data/ (regenerate via the documented pipeline). Requires Julia 1.11+. NHANES comparison requires separately downloaded CDC NHANES SLQ data; SHAP analysis requires Python packages via PyCall.
